title: Army man linked to viral dog slaughter video faces demotion, charges

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Philippine Army soldier has been relieved of his duties and faces possible demotion and formal charges over an alleged animal cruelty incident involving the slaughter of a dog that was recorded and posted on social media.
